description: Recompute identities against wild-type MAL63 and test whether Mal33p carries the mal63-13 disabling substitutions
code:
import requests, time, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
def gbtrans(acc, want):
    for _ in range(4):
        t=requests.get(E+"efetch.fcgi",params=dict(db="nuccore",id=acc,rettype="gb",retmode="text"),timeout=120).text
        if t.startswith("LOCUS"):
            for p in re.findall(r'/translation="([^"]*)"',t):
                p="".join(p.split())
                if len(p)==want: return p
        time.sleep(3)
    return None
def up(a): return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()

MAL63  = gbtrans("M36537",470)          # wild-type functional MAL63 (Kim & Michels 1988, PMID 3145816)
mal63_13 = up("E9P8G3")                 # AF003003, nonfunctional mutant allele
S={"Mal63p WILD TYPE (M36537, functional)":MAL63,
   "mal63-13p (AF003003, NON-functional)":mal63_13,
   "Mal23p (AF002704, functional inducible)":up("E9P8G2"),
   "Mal23-Cp (AF002703, functional constitutive)":up("E9P8G1"),
   "mal64p (M81158, non-functional)":up("Q9UVH4"),
   "Mal33p (P38157, S288C)":up("P38157"),
   "Mal13p (P53338, S288C)":up("P53338")}

def nw(a,b,gap=-6):
    n,m=len(a),len(b); sc=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); ptr=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    sc[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*gap; sc[0,:]=np.arange(m+1)*gap; ptr[1:,0]=1; ptr[0,1:]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=sc[i-1,j-1]+(2 if ai==b[j-1] else -2); u=sc[i-1,j]+gap; l=sc[i,j-1]+gap
            k=int(np.argmax((d,u,l))); sc[i,j]=(d,u,l)[k]; ptr[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; pairs=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        p=ptr[i,j]
        if p==0: pairs.append((i,j)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif p==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pairs[::-1]

LES=[280,307,355,356,357,358,364]   # positions where mal63-13 departs from wild-type MAL63
print("The seven substitutions that distinguish the NON-functional mal63-13 allele from wild-type MAL63")
print("(positions in MAL63 numbering; 6 of 7 lie in the maltose-responsive domain 283-470)\n")
hdr=f"{'allele':46s}"+"".join(f"{p:>7d}" for p in LES)
print(hdr); print("-"*len(hdr))
tab={}
for k,s in S.items():
    pr={i:j for i,j in nw(MAL63,s)}
    row=[s[pr[p]-1] if p in pr else "-" for p in LES]
    tab[k]=row
    print(f"{k:46s}"+"".join(f"{r:>7s}" for r in row))
print("\nMal33p matches wild-type MAL63 at",
      sum(1 for a,b in zip(tab["Mal33p (P38157, S288C)"],tab["Mal63p WILD TYPE (M36537, functional)"]) if a==b),
      "of 7 positions; it matches the non-functional mal63-13 allele at",
      sum(1 for a,b in zip(tab["Mal33p (P38157, S288C)"],tab["mal63-13p (AF003003, NON-functional)"]) if a==b),
      "of 7.")

DOM=[("Zn2Cys6 motif",8,34),("DNA binding",1,100),("transactivation core",60,283),
     ("inhibitory region",251,299),("maltose-responsive C-term",300,470),("whole protein",1,470)]
rows=[]
for k,s in S.items():
    if k.startswith("Mal63p WILD"): continue
    pr=nw(MAL63,s)
    for dn,lo,hi in DOM:
        sel=[(i,j) for i,j in pr if lo<=i<=hi]
        pid=100*np.mean([MAL63[i-1]==s[j-1] for i,j in sel])
        rows.append(dict(allele=k,domain=dn,n=len(sel),pct_identity_to_wildtype_Mal63p=round(pid,1)))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows); r.to_csv("mal33_identity_to_wildtype_MAL63.csv",index=False)
piv=r.pivot(index="allele",columns="domain",values="pct_identity_to_wildtype_Mal63p")[[d[0] for d in DOM]]
print("\nPer-domain identity to WILD-TYPE Mal63p (M36537), correcting the earlier mal63-13 reference:")
print(piv.to_string())
print("\nShift caused by the reference correction (Mal33p, whole protein): "
      f"{piv.loc['Mal33p (P38157, S288C)','whole protein']:.1f}% vs 71.1% against mal63-13p")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12.5,8.6),gridspec_kw=dict(height_ratios=[1.15,1]))
ax=axes[0]
order=["Mal23p (AF002704, functional inducible)","Mal23-Cp (AF002703, functional constitutive)",
       "mal63-13p (AF003003, NON-functional)","mal64p (M81158, non-functional)",
       "Mal33p (P38157, S288C)","Mal13p (P53338, S288C)"]
x=np.arange(len(DOM)); w=0.14
cols=["#e67e22","#c0392b","#8e44ad","#7d3c98","#117a65","#1a5276"]
for i,a in enumerate(order):
    ax.bar(x+(i-2.5)*w, piv.loc[a].values, w, label=a, color=cols[i],
           hatch="//" if ("NON-functional" in a or "non-functional" in a or "S288C" in a) else None,
           edgecolor="k", lw=0.4)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([d[0] for d in DOM], fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("% identity to wild-type Mal63p (M36537)"); ax.set_ylim(50,102)
ax.set_title("Identity to the wild-type Mal63p reference. The non-functional mal63-13 allele is 98.5% identical\n"
             "to wild type, while non-functional Mal33p and Mal13p are ~71%: divergence does not predict function")
ax.legend(fontsize=8, ncol=2)
ax=axes[1]
ax.axis("off")
cells=[[tab[k][i] for i in range(len(LES))] for k in S]
t=ax.table(cellText=cells, rowLabels=list(S.keys()),
           colLabels=[f"{p}" for p in LES], loc="center", cellLoc="center")
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(9); t.scale(1,1.5)
wt=tab["Mal63p WILD TYPE (M36537, functional)"]
for ri,k in enumerate(S):
    for ci in range(len(LES)):
        if tab[k][ci]==wt[ci]: t[(ri+1,ci)].set_facecolor("#d5f5e3")
        elif tab[k][ci]==tab["mal63-13p (AF003003, NON-functional)"][ci]: t[(ri+1,ci)].set_facecolor("#fadbd8")
ax.set_title("Residues at the seven positions that disable mal63-13 (MAL63 numbering).\n"
             "Green = wild-type residue, pink = the mal63-13 residue. Mal33p carries neither pattern.",
             fontsize=10, pad=18)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
